import socket, time, sys

def recv_all(s, t=2.0):
    s.settimeout(t)
    out=b''
    try:
        while True:
            d=s.recv(4096)
            if not d: break
            out+=d
    except socket.timeout:
        pass
    return out

s=socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',9000),timeout=10)
# minimal telnet: refuse all DO/WILL by responding WONT/DONT? just read initial neg
time.sleep(0.5)
_=recv_all(s,1.0)
# ctrl-c to clear any foreground job
s.sendall(b'\x03')
time.sleep(0.5)
s.sendall(b'\r')
time.sleep(0.5)
_=recv_all(s,1.0)

cmds = [
 "echo PHASE_START_$$",
 "kill %1 2>/dev/null; killall udhcpc 2>/dev/null; true",
 "ip link set eth0 up",
 "ip addr flush dev eth0 2>/dev/null; ip addr add 10.0.2.15/24 dev eth0",

 "echo PHASE_NET_DONE",
]
for c in cmds:
    s.sendall(c.encode()+b'\r')
    time.sleep(0.6)
data=recv_all(s,3.0)
sys.stdout.write(data.decode('utf-8','replace'))
s.close()
PYEOF
